case_for: Squarely in deeptech focus with a working prototype and demonstration flights (S1, R2).
Pre-seed stage the fund can lead (S2).
case_against: Commercial permission not granted and uncertain for years, with no plan B shown (R1, R4, G2).
No signed customer, and liability/insurance unaddressed (R3, R4).
Weak commercial co-founder on a business whose hardest problems are commercial and regulatory (S3).
Likely needs far more capital than a pre-seed cheque before first revenue (R5).
call_questions: If commercial permission takes three more years, what does the company sell in the meantime, and to whom?
Walk us through the regulator milestone sequence you are working to, and which step you have already completed.
Who carries liability if a drone fails over a populated area, and what has an insurer told you?
Name the hospital or logistics customer closest to signing and what they would pay per delivery.
We see the commercial side as your weakest point: why should we believe this team can sell and navigate regulators, not just fly?
what_would_change_our_view: A signed pilot or LOI with a paying customer, plus a documented regulator milestone plan and a liability/insurance answer, would change our view.
